But with headphones it is neat to hear the frogs calling to each other on either side of your head.  I recorded for 45 minutes, as I have time I'll upload some more samples.  In subsequent uploads you will be able to hear the frogs from other nearby ponds, plus other ambient evening sounds such as a distant train.
